title: One man band
summary: A one-minute clip of Rochus Keller performing as a one-man band: slap bass with the left hand, Rhodes and lead guitar with the right, and drums with the feet.
why: Shown by its creator on HN as a demonstration of his live multi-instrument setup built from stacked keyboards.

quote.text: This video of your live performance setup as a one-man band. Amazing.
